What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
If your order has already been shipped, we are unable to make changes to the shipping address or add items to the order. Once an order is in transit, it cannot be altered. However, we can discuss alternative solutions, such as arranging a return or placing a new order, depending on your needs.
If you would like us to check the status of your order and confirm whether it has shipped, please provide your order number. This will allow us to assist you more effectively.
